description:
Manage your volleyball team from ChatGPT with BenIkBij. Check upcoming matches and training sessions, see who is available, and update your own attendance.

Trainers and captains can plan events and recurring training, manage match lineups, review attendance statistics, and connect an official Nevobo competition calendar. Trainers can also create teams and manage player rosters.

Connect your BenIkBij account to get started. Available actions depend on your existing team permissions. Personal attendance updates require your account to be linked to a player on the team.

defaultPrompt: Which players are attending the next training?
Fill in my match availability based on my calendar.
